title: 大型弧形閘門安裝~Large radial-gate installation
focus: 以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門~Installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning
summary: 本課以以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門為主線，先用曲面水壓與水平力與曲面垂直分量界定水力與構造條件，再將吊索角度與張力、支臂長細與屈曲連結到同步行程與試運轉。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning through Curved pressure and horizontal force and Vertical pressure component, then connects Sling angle and tension and Arm slenderness and buckling to Synchronized travel and commissioning. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查曲面水壓與水平力：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN；再獨立檢查曲面垂直分量：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。敏感度：相同矩形投影寬度8m下，水深由6增至7m時水平靜水力由1412.64增至1922.76kN，增加36.11%；荷載按水深平方成長，不能用水位增加百分比直接放大全部構件反力。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 將核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Curved pressure and horizontal force: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. Independently examine Vertical pressure component: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body. Sensitivity: for an8m-wide rectangular projection, raising depth from6 to7m increases horizontal hydrostatic force from1412.64 to1922.76kN, or36.11 percent. This quadratic change does not imply the same factor for every component reaction. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. Use the following independent check: Review preload, grout continuity and support deformation before comparing load sharing. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 曲面水壓與水平力~Curved pressure and horizontal force
units.title: 曲面水壓與水平力~Curved pressure and horizontal force
units.mechanism: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。水平分量可用垂直投影面計算；此便利不表示閘門沒有重量、摩擦或偏心力矩，安裝幾何與受力必須共同核對。 驗證時應核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，並辨識以下失效情境：圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. Resolve the resultant into horizontal and vertical components. The horizontal component follows the vertical projection, but weight, friction and eccentricity still create moments that depend on installed geometry. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Diagnose it by the following check: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

units.practice: 交接時以核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 曲面垂直分量~Vertical pressure component
units.title: 曲面垂直分量~Vertical pressure component
units.mechanism: 曲面靜水力的垂直分量可由相應虛擬水體重量求得，方向取決於受壓面朝向與邊界。必須在自由體圖明示選用哪一水體，不能把曲面面積乘平均壓力當垂直力；此分量還會改變鉸支承反力與啟閉需求。 驗證時應以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較，並辨識以下失效情境：選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~The vertical hydrostatic component corresponds to an appropriate imaginary water volume, with direction set by surface orientation. Show that volume explicitly in the free-body diagram; curved area times average pressure is not automatically a vertical force. This component also affects bearing reaction and operating demand. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 雙鉸軸同軸量測~Trunnion coaxiality surveying
units.title: 雙鉸軸同軸量測~Trunnion coaxiality surveying
units.mechanism: 左右鉸軸需要符合設計同軸與高程條件，偏差會使支臂扭曲並增加軸承摩擦。兩端高差除跨度只是小角度幾何示意，不代表完整三維同軸誤差；還需量測軸線方向、支座位置與溫度變化後的相對移動。 驗證時應以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Both trunnions must satisfy alignment and elevation requirements. Misalignment twists arms and raises bearing friction. End-height difference divided by span illustrates one small-angle component, not full three-dimensional coaxiality; also survey axis orientation, support positions and temperature-dependent relative movement. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 軸承摩擦與啟閉~Bearing friction and operation
units.title: 軸承摩擦與啟閉~Bearing friction and operation
units.mechanism: 鉸軸摩擦把支承反力轉成阻力矩，潤滑不足、鏽蝕與偏心會改變摩擦係數。簡化庫侖摩擦式只估給定接觸狀態的量級，不能保證啟動與運轉摩擦相同；驗證應比較鉸反力、啟動力及運轉後溫升趨勢。 驗證時應比較啟動與穩定運轉的馬達電流及軸承溫升，並辨識以下失效情境：摩擦上升可能把額外彎矩傳入原本主要受壓支臂。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Trunnion friction converts bearing reaction into resisting torque. Lubrication, corrosion and misalignment change the coefficient. A Coulomb estimate describes a specified contact state and does not make breakaway and running friction identical; compare reaction, starting demand and subsequent temperature trends. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare motor current at breakaway and steady travel with bearing temperature rise. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Rising friction can introduce additional bending into primarily compressed arms. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 吊索角度與張力~Sling angle and tension
units.title: 吊索角度與張力~Sling angle and tension
units.mechanism: 門葉組裝吊運需依實際重心配置吊點，斜索張力會隨索角變小而增加。對稱兩索公式只適用靜態對稱分載，重心偏移、動態放大與吊具剛度需另列；教學幾何不能取代核准吊裝計畫與現場試吊觀測。 驗證時應以吊點荷重讀值核對分載並確認重心與吊索角度，並辨識以下失效情境：重心偏移可讓單側吊索超出對稱分載估計。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Assembly lifting requires pick points compatible with the actual center of mass. Sling tension increases as inclination becomes shallow. The symmetric two-sling equation assumes static equal sharing; eccentricity, dynamics and rigging stiffness require separate allowances and an approved lifting plan with observed load behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check sharing with pick-point load readings and confirm center of mass and sling angles. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An offset center of mass can overload one sling relative to symmetric sharing. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：totalWeight=400 kN; two symmetric slings60 degrees above horizontal; eachTension=400/(2*sin(60 degrees))=230.940 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: totalWeight=400 kN; two symmetric slings60 degrees above horizontal; eachTension=400/(2*sin(60 degrees))=230.940 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 面板支承間彎曲~Skinplate bending between supports
units.title: 面板支承間彎曲~Skinplate bending between supports
units.mechanism: 門葉面板把分布水壓傳到肋材，再經主梁與支臂送至鉸軸，支承距離會強烈影響局部彎曲。簡支條帶模型只示範一維傳力，實際板的雙向作用、焊接拘束與曲率需另分析；驗證須核對肋距及面板厚度。 驗證時應量測肋間距與板厚並比較受水壓後局部撓度，並辨識以下失效情境：肋材漏焊或接續不良可能延長實際無支承跨度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~The skin transfers distributed pressure to stiffeners, girders and arms. Support spacing strongly affects local bending. A simply supported strip illustrates one-dimensional action only; plate action, welded restraint and curvature need separate treatment. Verify actual stiffener spacing and thickness before comparing measured deformation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure stiffener spacing and thickness and compare local deflection under water pressure. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Missing or defective stiffener welds can increase the effective unsupported span. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 支臂長細與屈曲~Arm slenderness and buckling
units.title: 支臂長細與屈曲~Arm slenderness and buckling
units.mechanism: 支臂承受壓力時需檢查整體穩定與局部板件屈曲，端部拘束會影響有效長度。歐拉公式僅適用理想彈性細長柱，不涵蓋初始彎曲、殘餘應力與組合彎矩；安裝偏差應進入模型而非只驗收截面積。 驗證時應核對支臂初始直線度接點拘束與局部板件尺寸，並辨識以下失效情境：鉸軸摩擦或偏心彎矩會降低理想軸壓模型的適用性。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Compressed arms require global and local stability checks. End restraint affects effective length. Euler theory applies to an ideal elastic slender member and omits imperfections, residual stress and combined bending; installed deviations belong in the model rather than being ignored after checking area alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check arm straightness, connection restraint and local plate dimensions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Trunnion friction or eccentric bending invalidates a purely axial idealization. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 支座錨定與分載~Support anchorage and load sharing
units.title: 支座錨定與分載~Support anchorage and load sharing
units.mechanism: 鉸支座透過底板、錨定與混凝土把反力傳入壩墩，各螺栓受力通常因偏心與底板彈性而不均。平均分載只能作帳務起點；灌漿空洞、預緊差異與裂縫會改變接觸及荷載路徑，須配合局部模型與檢測。 驗證時應核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載，並辨識以下失效情境：底板局部離縫會把拉力集中到少數錨栓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Trunnion supports transfer load through plates, anchorage and concrete. Eccentricity and plate flexibility generally make bolt forces unequal. Equal sharing is only a bookkeeping start; grout voids, preload variation and cracking alter contact and load paths and need local analysis and inspection. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Review preload, grout continuity and support deformation before comparing load sharing. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Local baseplate separation concentrates tension in a few anchors. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 側封壓縮與摩擦~Side-seal compression and friction
units.title: 側封壓縮與摩擦~Side-seal compression and friction
units.mechanism: 側封須在門葉運動範圍維持接觸，過少壓縮會漏水，過多則增加摩擦與磨耗。壓縮百分比是幾何量，不是接觸壓力的通用換算式；橡膠硬度、溫度與支承形狀需按供應商資料及實際接觸試驗確認。 驗證時應沿全行程量測封面接觸與啟閉阻力並定位滲漏，並辨識以下失效情境：偏斜門葉可使一側過壓縮而另一側失去密封。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Side seals need contact throughout travel. Too little compression leaks, while too much raises friction and wear. Compression percentage is geometry rather than a universal contact-pressure law; elastomer hardness, temperature and support shape require supplier information and representative contact testing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure seal contact and operating resistance throughout travel and locate leakage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A skewed gate can overcompress one seal while unloading the other. units.anchor: 同步行程與試運轉~Synchronized travel and commissioning
units.title: 同步行程與試運轉~Synchronized travel and commissioning
units.mechanism: 雙側啟閉機不同步會造成門葉扭轉與封面不均，試運轉需逐工況核對行程、負荷與停留位置。兩側位移差除跨距僅是小角度扭斜指標；最終判定還需軸承、支臂與密封反應，不能只依位置訊號相近。 驗證時應同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持，並辨識以下失效情境：位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Unsynchronized drives skew the leaf and seals. Commissioning must compare travel, load and stopping positions across operating states. Differential travel divided by span is only a small-angle skew indicator; acceptance also requires bearing, arm and seal response rather than nearly equal position signals alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
